LOO-718 · Explore · 03 Nov 2026
Proposed mobile Task creation

An idea. A place to work.
A running Task.

What should come first when you start work from your phone? Try three starting points. Back returns to the familiar Task list.

Interactive sketches. Voice inserts sample text; you can also type. Nothing is recorded, sent, or created. Destinations and agent responses are examples. The keyboard shown when typing is your browser’s own.

01 / DESCRIBE FIRST

One quick sheet

Say what you want. Reuse your last workspace, with the destination always visible.

9:41▰ 100%

Fast for familiar work. The risk is starting in the wrong place because the default looked right.

02 / WORKSPACE FIRST

Choose where, then ask

Pick the repository and Machine before composing. Start with a clear destination.

9:41▰ 100%

Clear across several Machines. Every new idea needs a destination decision before you can describe it.

03 / VOICE FIRST

Talk it through

Capture the idea. Let Loopflow help place it and turn it into a brief you can edit.

9:41▰ 100%

Less form-filling on the move. Interpretation adds time and can change intent; review comes before starting.

The decisions these explore

  1. Which starting point feels right: 1a describe first, 1b workspace first, or 1c talk it through?
  2. Should voice 2a transcribe your words, or 2b help shape a brief with questions?
  3. Should the main action 3a create and start, or 3b save the Task for later?

Built from mobile-task-brief.md, mobile-prototypes.md and mobile-new-task-flows.md. Bundled Desktop typography and Loopflow Light/Dark colors. Browser-only state; refresh clears the sketches.
